design_effect: Single-input ordinary ALL signing is available without collecting both keys. Exact body/budget/context checks remain application requirements; no extra approval-signature subsystem is required.
review_scope: Connected GitHub primary-source excerpts read independently; no signer, private key, PK, witness or network submission used.

observations: ALL hashes ordered previous outpoints, sequences, outputs, payload, tx version, locktime, subnetwork and gas.
Each input signing message includes that input own populated source amount and script.
compute-commit sig-op hashing is conditional on version<1; version1 budgets are absent.
This is source verification of coverage, not a new cryptographic signing experiment.
createInputSignature accepts transaction, own input index, one PrivateKey and explicit optional SighashType; default is All.
It populates transaction contexts before calling sign_input; the new application must independently constrain the selected owner index/key.

signTransaction can leave a transaction partially signed; verify_sig=true verifies all populated inputs and therefore cannot serve as a successful first-half verification when the other input is unsigned.
